title: Street Walk Candid
how_to_pose: Walk slowly across frame, look away from camera, keep one hand touching jacket.
camera_angle: Eye level, slight side angle 30deg.

title: Crosswalk Pause
how_to_pose: Stop mid-crosswalk, one leg forward, shoulder turn back to lens.
camera_angle: Low angle, wide 24-28mm.

title: Wall Lean Relax
how_to_pose: Lean one shoulder on wall, cross ankles, keep hands in pockets.
camera_angle: Eye level, straight-on.

title: Stair Sit Portrait
how_to_pose: Sit one step higher, elbows on knees, chin slightly up.
camera_angle: Slight high angle, medium focal length.

title: Railway Handrail Lookback
how_to_pose: Hold handrail with one hand and look back over shoulder.
camera_angle: Behind subject, 45deg follow angle.

title: Phone Check Natural
how_to_pose: Look down at phone naturally, relax shoulders, soft smile.
camera_angle: Eye level, close half-body.

title: Coffee Cup Side Profile
how_to_pose: Hold coffee near face, profile to lens, eyes toward window light.
camera_angle: Side 90deg, chest-up framing.

title: Table Elbow Rest
how_to_pose: Rest one elbow on table, hand under chin, keep neck long.
camera_angle: Slight top-down, 35-50mm.

title: Window Light Soft Smile
how_to_pose: Stand near window, body at 45deg, smile with eyes not teeth.
camera_angle: Eye level, tight portrait.

title: Mirror Selfie Minimal
how_to_pose: Phone slightly above chest, weight on back leg, free hand on hip.
camera_angle: Mirror reflection, slight downward tilt.

title: Mirror Full Body Fit Check
how_to_pose: One foot ahead, angle body 30deg, keep lines straight.
camera_angle: Mirror center frame, 1x lens.

title: Hallway Runway
how_to_pose: Walk toward camera with long stride, shoulders open.
camera_angle: Low angle from waist level.

title: Neon Night Stand
how_to_pose: Stand still, slight chin down, hands relaxed by sides.
camera_angle: Eye level, center composition.

title: Neon Backlight Silhouette
how_to_pose: Face away from light source, outline profile clearly.
camera_angle: Backlight against neon sign.

title: Street Lamp Spin
how_to_pose: Hold jacket hem and do a gentle spin for motion blur.
camera_angle: Tripod eye level, slower shutter.

title: Rooftop Skyline Back
how_to_pose: Back to camera, head turned slightly to side, hands on rail.
camera_angle: Behind subject, wide frame.

title: Rooftop Sit Edge Safe
how_to_pose: Sit safely away from edge line, knees bent, one arm over knee.
camera_angle: 45deg side shot, medium crop.

title: Park Bench Relax
how_to_pose: Sit diagonal on bench, one ankle on opposite knee.
camera_angle: Eye level from bench front corner.

title: Grass Lie Down Sky
how_to_pose: Lie on grass, hands near hair, eyes looking upward.
camera_angle: Top-down from above head.

title: Tree Shadow Portrait
how_to_pose: Stand in patterned shadows, keep face turned to brighter side.
camera_angle: Chest-up at eye level.

title: Beach Walk Barefoot
how_to_pose: Walk along shoreline and hold sandals in one hand.
camera_angle: Wide frame, side follow.

title: Beach Back To Camera
how_to_pose: Stand facing ocean, one hand fixing hair.
camera_angle: Behind subject, horizon on top third.

title: Sea Wall Sit
how_to_pose: Sit on sea wall with legs angled to one side.
camera_angle: Eye level from 30deg side.

title: Couple Hand In Hand Walk
how_to_pose: Walk naturally holding hands and look at each other.
camera_angle: Follow from behind at waist height.

title: Couple Forehead Touch
how_to_pose: Stand close, forehead touch, eyes closed for a beat.
camera_angle: Tight portrait at eye level.

title: Couple Back Hug
how_to_pose: One person hugs from behind, both shoulders relaxed.
camera_angle: Half-body 45deg.

title: Friend Group Jump
how_to_pose: Count down and jump together with knees tucked slightly.
camera_angle: Wide low angle, burst mode.

title: Friend Group Triangle
how_to_pose: Arrange heights in triangle shape, center person slightly front.
camera_angle: Eye level, wide 24-28mm.

title: Friend Group Sitting Curb
how_to_pose: Sit on curb at different levels and vary hand placement.
camera_angle: Front eye level, medium-wide.

title: Graduation Cap Toss
how_to_pose: Hold cap near chest then throw together on cue.
camera_angle: Low angle to capture cap arc.

title: Campus Stair Walk
how_to_pose: Walk down stairs slowly, look to side, bag over one shoulder.
camera_angle: Below stairs, centered lines.

title: Library Book Peek
how_to_pose: Hold book partially covering mouth, eyes to camera.
camera_angle: Eye level, close crop.

title: Scooter Side Stand
how_to_pose: Stand beside scooter, one hand on handle, one foot pointed out.
camera_angle: Three-quarter side frame.

title: Bike Ride Push
how_to_pose: Walk bike forward while looking down with relaxed smile.
camera_angle: Side tracking shot.

title: Car Window Mood
how_to_pose: Lean near open window, one hand touching frame.
camera_angle: Outside-in, shallow depth.

title: Rain Umbrella Walk
how_to_pose: Walk with transparent umbrella, chin slightly down.
camera_angle: Front 45deg with reflections.

title: Umbrella Backlight Neon
how_to_pose: Hold umbrella high and face neon backlight.
camera_angle: Backlight silhouette.

title: Bridge Rail Centered
how_to_pose: Stand centered between rails, one foot slightly forward.
camera_angle: Straight center, leading lines.

title: Tunnel Perspective Walk
how_to_pose: Walk through tunnel with long stride and relaxed arms.
camera_angle: Very low centerline shot.

title: Skateboard Sit Cool
how_to_pose: Sit on board edge, elbows on knees, confident look.
camera_angle: Low angle close full-body.

title: Skate Push Motion
how_to_pose: Push skateboard lightly for motion while body stays stable.
camera_angle: Side panning shot.

title: Basket Court Casual
how_to_pose: Hold ball at hip, one foot on line, look over shoulder.
camera_angle: Eye level, slight wide.

title: Headphones Street Vibe
how_to_pose: Wear headphones, close eyes slightly, hand touching ear cup.
camera_angle: Half-body at eye level.

title: Bookstore Aisle Browse
how_to_pose: Browse shelf naturally, pull one book and glance to lens.
camera_angle: Aisle side angle, medium shot.

title: Record Store Flip
how_to_pose: Flip vinyl stack, pause on one cover and smile softly.
camera_angle: 45deg shoulder view.

title: Arcade Neon Play
how_to_pose: Hands on arcade controls, laugh naturally toward friend.
camera_angle: Side close shot with neon bokeh.

title: Food Court Tray Walk
how_to_pose: Carry food tray with both hands, walk and chat naturally.
camera_angle: Front follow shot at chest height.

title: Festival Crowd Glow
how_to_pose: Face stage light, hands near face, relaxed expression.
camera_angle: Close-up with back bokeh lights.

title: Polaroid Cover Face
how_to_pose: Hold instant photo over one eye and tilt head slightly.
camera_angle: Tight portrait eye level.

title: Sunset Over Shoulder
how_to_pose: Stand with sun behind, turn head over shoulder with soft smile.
camera_angle: Backlit 45deg portrait.

title: Golden Hour Hair Flip
how_to_pose: Do a gentle hair flip while keeping chin up.
camera_angle: Burst mode side angle.

title: Shadow Line Face
how_to_pose: Place face across a shadow edge and keep expression neutral.
camera_angle: Tight crop eye level.
